scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Guard]
Welcome to the Training Grounds.
You are now in the outer court yard. Please go inside the castle to begin your training.
scripts.translation:
[训练场卫兵]
欢迎来到训练场。
您现在位于外庭院，请进入城堡开始您的训练。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Guard]
Come in!
I would like
to welcome you to
the Training Grounds!
scripts.translation:
[训练场卫兵]
请进！
欢迎您来到训练场！

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Guard]
Go, Novice, go!
Fight, and grow stronger! Look towards a brighter tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[训练场卫兵]
去吧，初心者，去吧！
战斗，变得更强！向着更美好的明天前进！

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Guard]
In here, you can prepare
yourself for your future
adventures throughout the
Ragnarok world!
scripts.translation:
[训练场卫兵]
在这里，您可以为未来在仙境传说世界中的冒险做好准备！

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
Hello, you look to be new here.
What is your name?
scripts.translation:
[训练场接待员]
您好，您看起来是新来的。
请问您叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
Sorry, but I don't think I heard
you correctly
scripts.translation:
[训练场接待员]
抱歉，我想我可能没有听清楚。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
Welcome!
You are at the entrance
of the ^3355FFTraining Grounds^000000.
scripts.translation:
[训练场接待员]
欢迎光临！
您现在位于^3355FF训练场^000000的入口处。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
If you're new
to the Ragnarok world,
please choose the
^3355FFTraining Grounds Introduction^000000
menu for more information.
scripts.translation:
[训练场接待员]
如果您是仙境传说世界的新人，
请选择^3355FF训练场介绍^000000菜单以获取更多信息。

scripts.text: Apply for training.
scripts.translation: 申请训练

scripts.text: Direct access to Ragnarok Online.
scripts.translation: 直接进入仙境传说

scripts.text: ^3355FFTraining Grounds Introduction.^000000
I need a moment to think.
scripts.translation: 我需要考虑一下

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
Thank you for applying for Novice training. For detailed information of each training course, please inquire the Guides for assistance.
scripts.translation:
[训练场接待员]
感谢您申请初心者训练。如需了解各训练课程的详细信息，请咨询向导。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
When you have questions about the training course process, please feel free to ask any of the Tutors.
scripts.translation:
[训练场接待员]
如果您对训练课程流程有任何疑问，请随时向导师咨询。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
You will now be transferred
to the Training Grounds.
scripts.translation:
[训练场接待员]
您现在将被传送到训练场。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
I understand.
Please do your
best, and I wish you
the best of luck!
scripts.translation:
[训练场接待员]
我明白了。
请加油，祝您一切顺利！

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
This training grounds was established in order to provide useful information to new players of Ragnarok Online by the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom's Board of Education.
scripts.translation:
[训练场接待员]
本训练场由卢恩·米德加兹王国教育部设立，旨在为仙境传说的新玩家提供有用的信息。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
The training course is organized into two parts: the Basic Knowledge classes, and Field Combat training.
scripts.translation:
[训练场接待员]
训练课程分为两部分：基础知识课程和野外战斗训练。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
Through the first course, players will learn the necessary knowledge for a smoother gaming experience.
scripts.translation:
[训练场接待员]
通过第一门课程，玩家将学习到有助于更顺畅游戏体验的必要知识。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
In Field Combat Training,
players will engage in actual battle with weak monsters so they can learn the basics of fighting.
scripts.translation:
[训练场接待员]
在野外战斗训练中，
玩家将与弱小的魔物进行实战，
以学习战斗的基础知识。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
With this battle practice,
players will be able to gain more experience before they enter the real world.
scripts.translation:
[训练场接待员]
通过这种实战练习，
玩家可以在进入真实世界之前
获得更多的经验值。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
At the end of the training, we will provide an introduction to the 1st Job Classes. This will help players decide which job class is best for them.
scripts.translation:
[训练场接待员]
训练结束后，我们将介绍一转职业。
这将帮助玩家决定哪个职业最适合自己。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
If you wish to participate in the training grounds, please choose '^3355FFApply for training^000000' in the menu.
scripts.translation:
[训练场接待员]
如果您想参加训练场，请在菜单中选择'^3355FF申请训练^000000'。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
Otherwise, if you want to skip the basic training and immediately enter the world of Ragnarok Online, please choose '^3355FFDirect access to Ragnarok Online^000000.'
scripts.translation:
[训练场接待员]
否则，如果您想跳过基础训练并直接进入仙境传说，请选择'^3355FF直接进入仙境传说^000000'。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
I understand.
Please, take your time.
scripts.translation:
[训练场接待员]
我明白了。
请慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Hm...?
What are you
still doing here?
Oh, you used a ^3355FFButterfly Wing^000000, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
嗯...？
你怎么还在这里？
哦，你用了^3355FF蝴蝶翅膀^000000，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Shion]
No, no, no~
You're supposed to use the Butterfly Wing when you want to go back to a town ^666666after^000000 completing your training here, alright?
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
不，不，不~
你应该在^666666完成^000000这里的训练后，
想要回到城镇时才使用蝴蝶翅膀，明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Now, let me send
you back to the
Training Grounds.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
现在，让我送你
回训练场。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
The Training Grounds
are located just past
the bridge located
to the right.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
训练场就在
右边那座桥的
另一边。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Although you'll
be sitting through
some classes, you
won't regret it.
Now, go for it!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
虽然你要
上几节课，
但你不会后悔的。
现在，去吧！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Hey...
You little rascal!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
嘿...
你这小捣蛋鬼！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Wait...
Calm down Shion.
You're a professional
trainer! Don't get all
upset at a Novice!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
等等...
冷静点，紫苑。
你是专业的
训练师！别对一个
初心者发火！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Go and cross the bridge to the right, right now! ^666666*Ahem*^000000 You'll see and castle, and inside you can meet all sorts of tutors.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
现在就去右边的桥那边！^666666*咳*^000000 你会看到一座城堡，里面可以见到各种各样的导师。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
If you can't see the entrance, just change your in-game camera angle by holding down the ^3355FFright Mouse button^000000 and dragging your mouse. Easy, right?
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
如果你看不到入口，只需按住^3355FF鼠标右键^000000并拖动鼠标来改变游戏内的摄像机角度。很简单，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Shion]
To reset your camera angle,
just double-click the right Mouse button. Okay then, take care!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
要重置摄像机角度，
只需双击鼠标右键。好了，保重！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Oh, and before you leave,
learn how to treat a lady nice, okay? Then they might give you gifts like this!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
哦，在你离开之前，
学会如何善待女士，好吗？那样她们可能会给你这样的礼物！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Huh...?
Why are you
still here?
^666666*Sigh...*^000000

[Shion]
Hey, when you enter the Training Grounds, you'll learn all sorts of things that will help you play the game. You'll even have the chance to get zeny and other rewards.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
嘿，当你进入训练场时，你会学到各种有助于玩游戏的东西。你甚至有机会获得Zeny和其他奖励。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
You can even gain
experience like this!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
你甚至可以
像这样获得
经验值！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Everything you'll learn here in the Training Grounds will benefit your gameplay. So just think positive, okay?
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
你在训练场学到的一切都会对你的游戏有帮助。所以保持积极的心态，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Hello there~
Welcome to the
Training Grounds!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
你好呀~
欢迎来到训练场！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Let's see.
Your name is...
{0}.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
让我看看。
你的名字是...
{0}。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
My name is Shion.
Yes, this is the first time we've met, of course. Hahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
我叫紫苑。
没错，这是我们第一次见面，当然啦。哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Now that we've met, is there anything I can help you with?
I'm here for your questions~
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
既然我们见面了，有什么我可以帮你的吗？
我在这里就是为了回答你的问题~

scripts.text: Where should I go?
scripts.translation: 我该去哪里？

scripts.text: About Basic Interfaces.
scripts.translation: 关于基础界面。

scripts.text: Who the crap are you?
scripts.translation: 你他妈是谁？

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Do you see the bridge to your
right side? Just cross the bridge and you'll arrive at a castle. All you have to do is walk inside!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
你看到右边的桥了吗？
只需走过那座桥，你就会到达一座城堡。
你只需要走进去就行了！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
The entrance of the castle
is a ^4D4DFFspinning white light^000000. These portals are what allow you to move from one zone to another.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
城堡的入口是一个^4D4DFF旋转的白色光柱^000000。
这些传送门可以让你从一个区域移动到另一个区域。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Do you know how to move?
Left click on a spot, and you'll walk over to that spot. Piece of cake, huh?
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
你知道怎么移动吗？
左键点击一个位置，你就会走到那个位置。小菜一碟，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Shion]
So go for it!
Basically, you must enter the castle in order to start your adventures.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
那就去吧！
基本上，你必须进入城堡才能开始你的冒险。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
There are soldiers
at the entrance, so don't
worry about getting lost.
Take care now~!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
入口处有士兵，
所以不用担心迷路。
再见啦~！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Basic Interfaces...
Do you know what Click, Double-click and Drag mean?
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
基础界面...
你知道点击、双击和拖拽是什么意思吗？

scripts.text:
[Shion]
When you press the
left Mouse button once,
that is a click. When you press the mouse button twice in a row, that's a double-click.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
当你按一次鼠标左键时，
那就是点击。当你连续按两次鼠标按键时，那就是双击。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Dragging is when you move your Mouse while holding down the
Mouse button after clicking on something.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
拖拽是指你在点击某物后，
按住鼠标按键的同时移动鼠标。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Before we start talking about
the Basic Interfaces, you should remember these terms, just because we'll be using them frequently.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
在我们开始讨论基础界面前，
你应该记住这些术语，因为我们会经常用到它们。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Inside the castle, there is a Basic Interfaces Tutor who can teach you the basics more clearly, okay? Enter the castle to start your training.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
城堡里有一位基础界面导师，
他可以更清楚地教你基础知识，好吗？进入城堡开始你的训练吧。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
The entrance
of the castle is
a ^4D4DFFspinning white light^000000.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
城堡的入口
是一个^4D4DFF旋转的白色光柱^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
There are soldiers
at the entrance, so don't
worry about getting lost.
Take care now~!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
入口处有士兵，
所以不用担心迷路。
再见啦~！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Me? I'm Shion!
But that's a rude way of asking! I'm volunteering my time and effort here, so you've got to show me a little bit of respect at least!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
我？我是紫苑！
但你问问题的方式真粗鲁！我在这里是自愿付出时间和精力，所以至少要对表现出一点尊重！

scripts.text:
[Kris]
You've completed all the essential courses. Have you spoken to the assistant tutors already? The field combat training will be your next course. Would you like to proceed?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
你已经完成了所有基础课程。你之前和助教们交谈过了吗？下一门课程是野外战斗训练。你想继续吗？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text: No, I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 不，我稍后再来。

scripts.text: Send me to a town!
scripts.translation: 送我回城镇！

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Your next course is Field Combat training. Please listen carefully to your next trainer, and I hope you pass the course. Godspeed.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
你的下一门课程是野外战斗训练。请认真听下一位导师的讲解，祝你顺利通过考试。加油。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Alright then. In the meantime, you might want to speak to the assistant tutors, as the basic information taught in the essential courses may not be enough for new adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
好的。在此期间，建议你多和助教们交流，因为基础课程中教授的信息对于新冒险者来说可能还不够。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Feel free to come back any time when you need my assistance.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
如果你需要帮助，随时欢迎回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
So, would you like to be sent to a town? If you're confident that you've learned enough, head over to the right and speak to the ^3355FFKafra Employee^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
那么，你想被传送到城镇吗？如果你确信自己已经学得足够多了，请往右边走，去和^3355FF卡普拉 职员^000000交谈。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
The Kafra Services are very convenient once you get out into the real world. Their Teleport Service can be used to travel from town to town, and you can keep your items safe in the Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
当你进入真实世界后，卡普拉服务会非常方便。你可以使用瞬间移动服务在城镇之间旅行，也可以将物品安全地存放在卡普拉仓库中。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
We may never meet again, but I hope you grow stronger and become a great adventurer. Godspeed.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
我们可能不会再见面了，但我希望你能变得更强，成为一名伟大的冒险者。加油。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Hello, may I see your
proof of registration?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
你好，请出示你的注册证明。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Ah, {0}, you've applied for an old training course that we no longer provide for our trainees. Let me issue a new proof of registration for you.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
啊，{0}，你申请的是我们不再为学员提供的旧版培训课程。让我为你签发一份新的注册证明。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Okay, now
you're ready to go.
In my class, I teach the
use of the most basic
interfaces.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
好了，现在你准备好出发了。在我的课上，我教的是最基础的界面操作。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
{0}.
would you like to learn
more about interface
fundamentals?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
{0}，你想了解更多关于界面基础知识的内容吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Nah, I'm a pro~
scripts.translation: 不，我是专家~

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kris]
First, it's possible to move every interface window on your screen by dragging the window. Just click on the window, hold down the mouse button and move your mouse.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
首先，你可以通过拖动来移动屏幕上的任何界面窗口。只需点击窗口，按住鼠标按钮并移动鼠标即可。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Now, let me explain each interface window according to their default positions on your screen.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
现在，让我根据它们在屏幕上的默认位置，逐一解释每个界面窗口。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
At the upper left side of your screen, you will see a window with your character name and level. This is the ^3355FFBasic Information Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
在屏幕的左上角，你会看到一个显示角色名称和等级的窗口。这是^3355FF基础信息窗口^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Let me give you
some experience points.
Keep an eye on your Basic Info Window and observe the change in your Base Level experience gauge.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
让我给你一些经验值。请留意你的基础信息窗口，观察基础等级经验值条的变化。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
But...
I guess you're already familiar with the Base Level experience gauge.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
不过...我想你已经熟悉基础等级经验值条了。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Did you see...?
As you gain experience,
the experience gauge fills up.
Once it is 100 % full, you gain an experience level, and the gauge is reset to 0.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
你看到了吗？随着你获得经验值，经验值条会逐渐填满。当它达到100%时，你会提升一个经验等级，然后经验值条会重置为0。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
At the bottom of the Basic Info Window, you will see two different experience gauge bars. The top bar is for your current Base Level, and the bottom one displays experience for your current Job Level.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
在基础信息窗口的底部，你会看到两个不同的经验值条。上面的条显示当前基础等级的经验值，下面的条显示当前职业等级的经验值。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
When the Job Level
Experience bar is filled, you will earn a Job Level, and a ^3355FFSkill Point^000000. Skill Points are spent to learn skills for your character.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
当职业等级经验值条填满时，你将提升一个职业等级，并获得一个^3355FF技能点^000000。技能点用于学习角色的技能。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
On the right side
of the Basic Info window,
you will see various
Menu buttons.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
在基础信息窗口的右侧，你会看到各种菜单按钮。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Clicking these Menu buttons will open other Interface Windows, such as the Inventory Window
or Party Window.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
点击这些菜单按钮会打开其他界面窗口，例如物品栏窗口或队伍窗口。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Now...
The ^3355FFChat Window^000000 is
located at the bottom
of your screen.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
现在...
^3355FF聊天窗口^000000位于屏幕的底部。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
At the bottom right of the Chat Window, you should see 2 blue buttons. The left button allows you to change your chatting options.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
在聊天窗口的右下角，你应该能看到两个蓝色按钮。左边的按钮用于更改你的聊天选项。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
The '^3355FFSend to All^000000' option
allows you to chat with
everyone on your screen.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
“^3355FF发送给全体^000000”选项允许你与屏幕上的所有人聊天。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
The '^3355FFSend to Party^000000' and '^3355FFSend to Guild^000000' options allows you to send messages to only members of your party or guild, regardless of how far they are.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
“^3355FF发送给队伍^000000”和“^3355FF发送给公会^000000”选项允许你仅向你的队伍或公会成员发送消息，无论他们距离多远。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
You can drag the Scroll Bar
on the right side of the Chat Window to review a conversation. Since the Chat Window is always active, you won't have any problem communicating with other players.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
你可以拖动聊天窗口右侧的滚动条来回顾对话。由于聊天窗口始终处于活动状态，你与其他玩家沟通不会有任何问题。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Now, one of the most important interfaces is the ^3355FFMini-Map^000000, located at the upper-right of your screen.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
现在，最重要的界面之一是位于屏幕右上角的^3355FF小地图^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
The red dots on the Mini-Map indicate locations of ^3355FFWarp Portals^000000 which connect to different zones.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
小地图上的红点表示连接不同区域的^3355FF传送之阵^000000的位置。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
If you've joined a party or a guild, the Mini-Map will also show you the location of your party or guild members if they are on the same map.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
如果你加入了队伍或公会，小地图还会显示你的队伍或公会成员的位置（如果他们在同一张地图上）。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Please click the Menu buttons
on the right side of your Basic Info window and familiarize yourself with the other interfaces.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
请点击基础信息窗口右侧的菜单按钮，熟悉其他界面。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Well, that was my brief overview on in-game interfaces. It might seem like a lot of information now, but it will soon become second nature.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
好了，这就是我关于游戏界面的简要概述。现在看起来信息可能很多，但很快就会变得习以为常。

scripts.text:

[Kris]
Let me give you a little bit of Job experience points. Open your Skill Window and distribute your Skill Points into ^3355FFBasic Skills^000000.

[克里斯]
让我给你一些职业经验值。打开你的技能窗口，并将技能点分配到^3355FF基本技能^000000上。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Now, why don't you speak to Edwin? He will teach you more regarding the basic use of Skills. Ah, and let me give you a small present: a Tattered Novice Ninja Suit!
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
现在，你不妨去和埃德温对话？他会教你更多关于技能基本用法的内容。啊，让我送你一份小礼物：初学者忍者斗篷！

[Kris]
Let me guide you
to the Field Combat
Training Course.
You can come back any time if you feel that you need a review.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
让我引导你前往野外战斗训练课程。如果你觉得需要复习，随时可以回来。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
How may I help you?
Can I see your proof of registration?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
有什么可以帮您的吗？
可以看一下您的注册证明吗？

scripts.text:
[Kris]
It seems that you haven't attended the Skill Information class yet. Please talk to a tutor to the very left of this room to attend his class.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
看来你还没有参加技能资讯课程。请去和这个房间最左边的导师对话，参加他的课程。

scripts.text: Thank you!
scripts.translation: 谢谢！

scripts.text: I'm tired of classes~
scripts.translation: 我受够了上课~

[Kris]
When you attend the Skill Information class, you'll gain a better understanding of the use of skills.
scripts.translation:

当你参加技能资讯课程时，你会对技能的使用有更深的理解。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Since the use of skills is integral to survival in Midgard, I strongly suggest that you attend the class. Come, I shall guide you there.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
因为在米德加尔特，技能的使用是生存的关键，所以我强烈建议你参加这门课程。来，我带你过去。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
I see. In that case, you must be ready for the Field Combat Training Course. Shall I send you there right away?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
我明白了。那么，你一定已经准备好参加野外战斗训练课程了。要我现在就送你过去吗？

scripts.text: No! W-wait!
scripts.translation: 不！等等！

scripts.text: Please do~!
scripts.translation: 请送我过去~！

scripts.text:
[Kris]
...?!
O...kay then.
Please come back
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
...？！
那...好吧。
等你准备好了再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Godspeed,
young Novice.

[克里斯]
祝你好运，
年轻的初心者。

Did you need more help?

scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
嗯...？
你还需要更多帮助吗？
看来你已经完成了所有基础课程。你和助教们对话过了吗？

scripts.translation: 送我下一门课！

啊！对，对。
我想你总得参加野外战斗训练课程吧。

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
Man, I'm so jealous of the instructors in the Field Combat Training Course. Teaching basic information is just soooo not as cool as beating stuff up.
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
天哪，我真羡慕野外战斗训练课程的讲师。教基础资讯实在没揍怪物那么酷。

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
Ah, right.
Field Combat.
I'm sending you now.
Good luck, kid!
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
啊，对。
野外战斗。
我现在就送你过去。
祝你好运，小孩！

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
You know about the
assistant tutors, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
你知道助教的事，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
Listen. The three of tutors in this room only teach the most basic information. The courses we teach are meant to be passed quickly.
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
听着。这个房间里的三位导师只教最基础的信息。我们教的课程是为了让你快速通过的。

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
But some people might benefit a little bit more if they learned some more detailed information.
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
不过，有些人如果能学到更详细的信息，可能会受益匪浅。

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
If you're completely new to Ragnarok, it couldn't hurt to attend the classes held by the assistant tutors at least once.
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
如果你是刚接触《仙境传说》的新人，至少去听一次助教们的课也不会有坏处。

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
A guy named Leo Handerson seems to know a lot about skills, so I think his knowledge would be useful to you.
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
有个叫里奥·汉德森的家伙似乎对技能很了解，我觉得他的知识对你会有用。

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
A town...?
What do I look like, your own personal Peco Peco?
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
城镇...？
我看起来像你的专属大嘴鸟吗？

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
That's right, you might be too young to know about that. Listen, if you want to move to a town, speak to the Kafra Lady to the right, okay?
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
没错，你可能还太小，不知道这些。听着，如果你想移动到城镇，去和右边的卡普拉女士对话，好吗？

scripts.translation: 我现在就要野外战斗训练！

I live for power
and die for power!
I shall teach you
my famous fatal blow!
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
我为力量而生，
为力量而死！
我要教你
我著名的攻击弱点！

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
I'm just pulling your chain!
I actually just teach you how to use your skills. I still live for power, though.
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
我在逗你玩呢！
我其实只是教你如何使用技能。不过，我确实还是为力量而活的。

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
In your Basic Info Window, click the ^3355FFSkill^000000 button to open your Skill Window. You can also press the '^3355FFAlt^000000' and '^3355FFS^000000' keys at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
在你的基础信息窗口中，点击^3355FF技能^000000按钮打开技能窗口。你也可以同时按下'^3355FFAlt^000000'和'^3355FFS^000000'键。

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
When your
Skill Window is open,
you'll see an icon labeled
'^3355FFBasic Skill^000000.'
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
当你的
技能窗口打开时，
你会看到一个标有
'^3355FF基本技能^000000'的图标。

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
Now, at the bottom of the Skill Window, the number of remaining Skill Points that you have is displayed.
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
现在，在技能窗口的底部，会显示你剩余的技能点数。

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
Open your Skill Window ('Alt' + 'S') and click the '^3355FFLv Up^000000' button next to the Basic Skill icon to allocate a Skill Point to your Basic Skills.
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
打开你的技能窗口（'Alt' + 'S'），点击基本技能图标旁边的'^3355FF升级^000000'按钮，将技能点分配给你的基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
Huh. Actually, your Job Level is higher that I thought. I guess you already know the basics about skills then.
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
嗯。实际上，你的职业等级比我想象的要高。看来你已经知道技能的基础知识了。

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
So did you distribute the skill points to your Basic Skills? You'll need to master the Basic Skills eventually, so it's a good idea.
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
那么，你把技能点分配给基本技能了吗？你最终需要掌握基本技能，所以这是个不错的主意。

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
For more detailed information on skills, go speak to Leo Handerson, one of the assistant tutors.
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
如果想了解更详细的技能信息，去和助教之一里奥·汉德森对话吧。

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
Oh, I almost forgot!
Let me teach you the ^3355FFFirst Aid^000000 skill. This skill will help you out a lot when you're in danger.
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
哦，我差点忘了！
让我教你^3355FF紧急治疗^000000技能。这个技能在你身处险境时会帮上大忙。

scripts.text:

the ^4A708BFirst Aid^3355FF skill.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你学会了
^4A708B紧急治疗^3355FF技能。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have gained a small
amount of Job experience.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你获得了一小部分职业经验值。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
Now, open your Skill Window
and check if you have the ^3355FFFirst Aid^000000 skill icon. To use it, you need to double-click that skill icon.
Now, try it!
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
现在，打开你的技能窗口，看看是否有^3355FF紧急治疗^000000的技能图标。要使用它，你需要双击该技能图标。
现在，试试看！

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
Active skills, like First Aid, require a certain amount of SP to use them. The First Aid skill is useful for Novices, since it refills a little bit of HP.
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
像紧急治疗这样的主动技能，需要消耗一定数量的SP才能使用。紧急治疗技能对初心者很有用，因为它能恢复少量的HP。

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
You've been
a good student,
so let me reward you!
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
你真是个好学生，
让我奖励你一下！

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
You've been
a good student,
so let me reward you!
Behold: bonus experience!
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
你真是个好学生，
让我奖励你一下！
看：奖励经验值！

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
Oh wait. You're much higher in level than I thought. Still, I'm proud of you!
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
哦，等等。你的等级比我想象的要高得多。不过，我为你感到骄傲！

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
Well, that's it for the essential fundamentals. If you want a more comprehensive lesson, you gotta speak to the assistant tutors.
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
好了，基础课程就到这里。如果你想上更全面的课程，得去和助教们对话。

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的。

Everyone in the
Training Grounds is
more than willing to
help you. Good luck!
scripts.translation:

训练场的每个人
都很乐意帮助你。
祝你好运！

好了，熟能生巧！让我送你去野外战斗训练那边。保重！

嘿嘿~！
好了，熟能生巧！让我送你去野外战斗训练那边。保重！

scripts.text:
[Alice]
Huh...?
Do you need help looking for someone? You seem to have completed all of the essential courses. Where do you need to go?
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝]
嗯...？
你需要帮忙找人吗？你似乎已经完成了所有基础课程。你需要去哪里？

嗯...
既然你已经学会了其他所有东西，
我想剩下的就只有野外战斗训练了。你想现在去上那节课吗？

scripts.text: Yes.

记得随时准备好我给你的物品，
并且穿好所有的装备，好吗？
那么，保重。

scripts.translation:

好的，没问题。
如果你需要任何帮助，
随时来找我。
