scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
When you talk to a Kafra Employee and ask for the Save Service, the location of where you will revive, after being defeated in battle, will be changed.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
当您与卡普拉 职员交谈并要求使用存档服务时，您在战斗中战败后复活的地点将会被更改。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Your Respawn Point is always the last place where you have saved. Using a Butterfly Wing will return you to the place where you
last saved.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
您的复活点始终是您最后一次存档的地点。使用蝴蝶翅膀将返回您最后一次存档的地点。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employoee]
The Save Service
is also provided by
the Kafra Corporation
free of charge~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
存档服务
也是由卡普拉公司
免费提供的哦~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Kafra Corporation is the world's largest company with a long and distinguished history on the Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
卡普拉公司是米德加尔特大陆上历史悠久、声名显赫的世界最大企业。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You can store and retrieve
your items in any town at your convenience. This Storage is shared by every character on one account.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
您可以在任何城镇方便地存取您的物品。这个仓库由同一账号下的所有角色共享。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
It's unreasonable to carry all of your items with you when you don't need them right away. Please use our Storage and keep your items safe and secure.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
当不需要立即使用所有物品时，随身携带它们是不合理的。请使用我们的仓库，让您的物品安全存放。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Our convenient Storage Service
is provided to our customers for a small fee which is different from town to town.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
我们方便实用的仓库服务
向顾客收取少量费用，
具体费用因城镇而异。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
However, you must be
at least ^3355FFBasic Skill Level 6^000000
to use the Storage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
但是，您必须至少达到
^3355FF基本技能等级 6^000000
才能使用仓库。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
There are 3 different item sections of the Storage into which items are organized: Consumable, Equipment and Etc.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
仓库中有3个不同的物品分类，物品按以下类别整理：消耗品、装备和其他。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
There are a maximum of 300 Inventory Slots in Kafra Storage, meaning you can have up to 300 different kinds of items in Storage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
卡普拉仓库最多有300个物品栏位，意味着您可以在仓库中存放多达300种不同的物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Remember though, that in the case of Equipment, each item takes up one Inventory Slot. The maximum number of items that can be placed in Kafra Storage is 30,000.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
请记住，对于装备而言，每件物品占用一个物品栏位。可以放置在卡普拉仓库中的物品总数上限为30,000件。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Kafra Corporation
provides our valued customers with a convenient Teleport Service which greatly cuts down on your
traveling time.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
卡普拉公司
为我们尊贵的顾客提供便捷的瞬间移动服务，
大大减少了您的旅行时间。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Our Teleport Service is safe and comfortable, and will allow you to fully explore the various lands of the Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
我们的瞬间移动服务安全舒适，
让您能够充分探索米德加尔特大陆的各个地区。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
We thank our valued customers for their great support and continue to provide them with the best
of service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
感谢我们尊贵的顾客的大力支持，
我们将继续为您提供最优质的服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Kafra Corporation
provides a Cart Rental Service to Merchants, as well as Blacksmiths and Alchemists.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
卡普拉公司为商人、铁匠和炼金术士提供手推车租赁服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The flamboyantly mysterious
^CE6300Super Novice^000000 can use Carts, but we officially don't have a contract with that class. Still, somehow...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
华丽而神秘的^CE6300超级初心者^000000也可以使用手推车，
但我们官方并没有与该职业签订合同。不过，不知为何...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Anyway, Merchants, Blacksmiths and Alchemists must also learn the ^3355FFPush Cart^000000 skill in order to be able to rent a cart.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
总之，商人、铁匠和炼金术士也必须学习^3355FF手推车^000000技能，
才能租赁手推车。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Cart Rental service
charge will differ from
town to town.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
手推车租赁服务的费用
因城镇而异。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Welcome to my class.
Choose the subject you
wish to learn more about.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
欢迎来到我的课堂。
请选择您想深入了解的主题。

scripts.text: Basic Info Window
scripts.translation: 基本信息窗口

scripts.text: Party Window
scripts.translation: 队伍窗口

scripts.text: Item Window
scripts.translation: 物品窗口

scripts.text: Option Window
scripts.translation: 选项窗口

scripts.text: Equipment Window
scripts.translation: 装备窗口

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Let's take a look at
the Basic Info Window,
shall we?
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
我们要不来看看
基本信息窗口？

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Your name, job, Basic Level,
and your Job Level are displayed in this window. ^800FFFBase level^000000 is your character's level.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
您的名字、职业、基础等级
和职业等级都显示在这个窗口中。^800FFF基础等级^000000是您角色的等级。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
The ^800fffJob Level^000000 shown under the
Base Level displays the Job level of your character. When you just start a job, you will be at
Job Level 1.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
显示在基础等级下方的^800fff职业等级^000000是您角色的职业等级。
当您刚开始一个职业时，您的职业等级为1。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
In the Basic Info window, your current experience points are displayed in the Base Level experience bar.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
在基本信息窗口中，您当前的经验值显示在基础等级经验条中。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Experience points in Ragnarok Online are indicated by percentage. Base and Job experience are separate from each other.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
仙境传说中的经验值以百分比表示。基础经验和职业经验是相互独立的。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
When the Base Level or
Job Level bar reaches 100 it will be raised by one level and the bar will then reset to 0 for the next level.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
当基础等级或职业等级条达到100时，
等级将提升一级，然后条会重置为0，以便进入下一级。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
HP stands for 'health points.'
When your HP is reduced to 0, you will faint and be unable to fight. You can either return to your spawn point, or wait for someone to revive you.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
HP代表“生命值”。
当您的HP降至0时，您将昏迷并无法战斗。您可以返回出生点，或者等待他人复活您。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
If you die in the fields or dungeons, you will receive
a ^FF0000-1 % EXP penalty^000000, so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
如果您在野外或副本中死亡，将会受到^FF0000-1% 经验值惩罚^000000，所以请小心。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
SP stands for 'spell points.'
When you become a 1st class, you will learn unique class skills of the class that will require SP to use. Your skill instructor can teach you more about skills.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
SP代表“技能点”。
当您转职为一转职业时，您将学习该职业独有的技能，使用这些技能需要消耗SP。您的技能导师可以向您介绍更多关于技能的信息。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
If you want to check the weight limit of the items you can carry, check the bottom left of the
Basic Info window.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
如果您想查看可携带物品的重量上限，请查看基本信息窗口的左下角。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
The current weight of the items you are carrying will be displayed next to your maximum weight limit.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
您当前携带物品的重量将显示在最大重量上限旁边。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
If you carry over 50 % of your maximum weight limit, your HP and SP will not be restored by resting, so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
如果您携带的物品重量超过最大重量上限的50%，休息时将无法恢复HP和SP，所以请小心。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
The numerical value next to the weight limit shows the current amount of Zeny, the currency of Midgard, that you possess.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
重量上限旁边的数值显示您当前拥有的Zeny数量，Zeny是米德加尔特大陆的货币。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
On the right side of the
Basic Info Window is a series of buttons that will open other interface windows. Click them one by one, and check what you can do with them.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
在基本信息窗口的右侧有一系列按钮，点击它们可以打开其他界面窗口。请逐一点击，看看它们的功能。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
The shortcut for minimizing and maximizing the Basic Info Window
is '^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFV^000000.'
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
最小化和最大化基本信息窗口的快捷键是'^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFV^000000'。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
You can open the Party Window
by clicking the ^3355FFfriend^000000 button in the Basic Info window. The shortcut for the Party Window is '^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFZ^000000.' You can use this window to check on the members of your party.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
您可以点击基本信息窗口中的^3355FF好友^000000按钮来打开队伍窗口。队伍窗口的快捷键是'^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFZ^000000'。您可以使用此窗口查看队伍成员的状态。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
The Party master can determine
the distribution of EXP and items to the party. You can also check the location of your party members on the Mini-Map.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
队伍长可以决定队伍中经验和物品的分配。您也可以在迷你地图上查看队伍成员的位置。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
In the Party Window, you can click on the ^3355FFFriend^000000 button to see your Friend List. You can use the
Friend List to send whispers
to your friends.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
在队伍窗口中，您可以点击^3355FF好友^000000按钮查看好友列表。您可以使用好友列表向您的朋友发送白幽灵（Whisper）。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
You can ask your skill instructor to learn more about organizing parties. But I guess you can also just try that on your own.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
您可以向您的技能导师请教更多关于组建队伍的知识。不过，我想您也可以自己尝试一下。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
The item window is divided into
3 sections: consumable items, equipment and other items.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
物品窗口分为3个部分：消耗品、装备和其他物品。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Your weight limit does limit the amount of items you can carry with you. When you're carrying too many things, place your extra stuff in Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
您的重量上限限制了您可以携带的物品数量。当您携带的物品过多时，请将多余的东西存入卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Also, equipment and consumable items can also be assigned to a Hotkey through the Hotkey bar.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
此外，装备和消耗品也可以通过快捷栏分配快捷键。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
The Hotkey window is opened by pressing ^3355FFF12^000000 key. The F1 to F9 keys are the designated hotkeys.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
按下^3355FFF12^000000键可以打开快捷栏窗口。F1到F9键是指定的快捷键。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
There are total of 3 sets
of Hotkeys. You can toggle
between Hotkey sets by
pressing the F12 button.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
总共有3组快捷键。您可以按F12键在不同的快捷键组之间切换。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
You can open the Option Window
by pressing the ^3355FFoption^000000 button in the Basic Info window. You can also press the '^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFO^000000' keys as well.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
您可以按下基本信息窗口中的^3355FF选项^000000按钮来打开选项窗口。您也可以按'^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFO^000000'键。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
In the Option Window, you can adjust sound, GUI skin, and the transparency of the skin.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
在选项窗口中，您可以调整声音、界面皮肤以及皮肤的透明度。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
With the sound button, you can turn the background music on or off, as well as adjust the volume. The same can be done for the sound effects.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
通过声音按钮，您可以开启或关闭背景音乐，并调整音量。音效也可以进行相同的设置。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
With the Skin option, you can change the GUI skin for the in-game windows. Scroll through the list of the skins you have and choose
a skin.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
通过“皮肤”选项，您可以更改游戏内窗口的界面皮肤。请在您拥有的皮肤列表中滚动浏览，并选择一款皮肤。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
You can also download official skins from our official website:
^0000FFhttp://iro.ragnarokonline.com^000000
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
您还可以从我们的官方网站下载官方皮肤：
^0000FFhttp://iro.ragnarokonline.com^000000

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
The Snap option allows your mouse cursor to automatically be placed on a target once it hovers within the target's vicinity.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
“弓身弹影”选项可以让您的鼠标光标在悬停于目标附近时自动锁定该目标。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
When you click to attack, your mouse cursor will automatically change into a sword shape. Skill and item targeting also work with the Snap function.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
当您点击攻击时，鼠标光标会自动变成剑的形状。技能和物品的目标锁定也支持“弓身弹影”功能。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
It might be useful or awkward if you're not used to it. But once you're familiar with the Snap function, you will be able to adjust your own snap options.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
如果您不习惯，这可能会显得有用或别扭。但一旦您熟悉了“弓身弹影”功能，您就可以调整自己的相关选项了。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Well, it all depends on your experience. That's all for the Option Window.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
好吧，这完全取决于您的使用习惯。以上就是选项窗口的全部内容了。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Click the ^3355FFequip^000000 button
in your Basic Info Window,
or just press the '^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFQ^000000' keys.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
点击基本信息窗口中的^3355FF装备^000000按钮，
或者直接按'^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFQ^000000'键。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
In the Equipment Window,
you will see the items currently equipped on your character. In the very beginning, every character is equipped with a Knife and
a Cotton Shirt.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
在装备窗口中，您可以看到角色当前装备的物品。在游戏初期，每个角色都装备有一把小刀和一件棉衬衫。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
There are 2 ways to change your equipment. Double-click equipment in the Inventory Window or click and drag an item into the
Equipment Window.
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
更改装备有两种方式：在物品栏窗口中双击装备，或者将物品拖拽到装备窗口中。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
You can also assign equipment to Hotkeys. This can be down when you drag equipment from the Inventory into the Hotkey Window.
('^3355FFF12^000000' key).
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
您还可以将装备分配给快捷键。只需将装备从物品栏拖拽到快捷键窗口即可（'^3355FFF12^000000'键）。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
If you have
any questions,
feel free to ask me~
scripts.translation:
[埃德温]
如果您有任何问题，
请随时问我~

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Welcome, new adventurer.
I, Jare Riotte will help you to learn about the fundamental
rules of your Character Statuses.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
欢迎，新的冒险者。
我是亚雷·里奥特，我将帮助您了解角色状态的基础规则。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Also known as 'Stats,'
your statuses are the fundamental building blocks of your character.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
也被称为“属性”，
您的状态是构成角色的基础要素。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
I am willing to help you learn about the statuses more than anything else, so feel free to ask me about character statuses you
may be wondering about.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
比起其他事情，我更愿意帮助您了解状态，所以如果您有任何关于角色状态的疑问，请随时问我。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
In Ragnarok Online,
the Character Statuses are Strength, Agility, Vitality, Intelligence, Dexterity and Luck.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
在《仙境传说》中，
角色状态包括力量、敏捷、体质、智力、灵巧和幸运。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
I want my class to proceed
according to your personal needs, so ask about the Status you wish to better understand. First, open your Status Window by using the '^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFA^000000' keys.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
我希望我的课程能根据您的个人需求进行，所以请询问您希望深入了解的状态。首先，请使用'^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFA^000000'键打开状态窗口。

scripts.text: Strength and Agility
scripts.translation: 力量和敏捷

scripts.text: Vitality and Intelligence
scripts.translation: 体质和智力

scripts.text: Dexterity and Luck
scripts.translation: 灵巧和幸运

scripts.text: I do not wish to continue.
scripts.translation: 我不想继续了。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Let me explain Strength first.
^4D4DFFStrength (STR)^000000 increases
^4D4DFFphysical attack damage (ATK) ^000000
and your ^4D4DFF maximum weight limit^000000.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
首先让我来解释一下力量。
^4D4DFF力量 (STR)^000000 会增加
^4D4DFF物理攻击伤害 (ATK)^000000
以及你的^4D4DFF最大负重上限^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
1 STR increases your physical attack damage by 1 point. A certain amount of attack damage bonus is given when the STR stat is increased to a multiple of 10.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
1点力量会增加1点物理攻击伤害。当力量数值达到10的倍数时，会获得额外的攻击伤害加成。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
The way the attack damage bonus is calculated is by taking the total strength value, removing the very last digit, and squaring the number you have left.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
攻击伤害加成的计算方法是：取力量总数值，去掉最后一位数字，然后将剩余的数字平方。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Let's say your attack is displayed as '48 + 1.' That's a total of 49 strength. When you remove the last digit, '9,' we are left with the number '4.' 4 multiplied by itself equals 16.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
假设你的攻击显示为“48 + 1”，这意味着总力量为49。去掉最后一位数字“9”，剩下数字“4”。4乘以4等于16。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
So the physical attack bonus is 16. Now, if you had a total of 50 STR, the attack bonus would be 25. And if your STR is 100, your attack bonus would be 100.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
所以物理攻击加成是16。如果你的总力量是50，攻击加成就是25。如果力量是100，攻击加成就是100。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Okay, now let's move
on to Agility (AGI).
Agility affects your Flee Rate and Attack Speed. The higher your Flee Rate, the better chance you have of avoiding enemy attacks.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
好的，现在我们来谈谈敏捷 (AGI)。
敏捷影响你的闪避率和攻击速度。闪避率越高，你避开敌人攻击的机会就越大。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Your Flee Rate
is equal to the number
of your Base Level added
to your AGI.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
你的闪避率
等于你的基础等级
加上你的敏捷值。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
So if you have 40 AGI and you're at Base Level 30, your Flee Rate would be 70. It's so simple! Following the Flee Rate formula, your flee rate will be a total of 70.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
所以如果你有40点敏捷，基础等级是30级，你的闪避率就是70。很简单吧！根据闪避率公式，你的闪避率总计为70。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Now, AGI only relates to normal Flee Rate. Perfect Dodge is another factor that determines success in dodging attacks, but we'll talk about that when we discuss
the LUK stat.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
现在，敏捷只关系到普通闪避率。完美闪避是决定躲避攻击成功的另一个因素，但我们讨论幸运 (LUK) 属性时再谈这个。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Another benefit to increasing AGI is that your Attack Speed (ASPD) will also increase, meaning the time between your melee attacks will be reduced.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
提高敏捷的另一个好处是你的攻击速度 (ASPD) 也会增加，这意味着你近战攻击之间的间隔会变短。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
ASPD, however,
differs by Job Class,
so please remember that.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
不过，攻击速度
因职业而异，
请记住这一点。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
^666666*Whew!*^000000
That's almost too
much excitement for
one day. Shall we move
on to the next subject?
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
^666666*呼！*^000000
这一天真是
太令人兴奋了。
我们要继续下一个主题吗？

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Our next subject
will be Vitality (VIT)
and Intelligence (INT).
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
我们的下一个主题
是体质 (VIT)
和智力 (INT)。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
^4D4DFFVitality^000000 affects the ^4D4DFFmaximum HP, amount of HP restoration and defense^000000. The amount of HP increased by VIT is differs by your job class.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
^4D4DFF体质^000000 影响^4D4DFF最大HP、HP恢复量和防御力^000000。体质增加的HP量因职业而异。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Out of all the Job Classes, the Swordman class benefits most
from increases in VIT.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
在所有职业中，剑士职业从体质增加中获益最多。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Let's check defense.
On your stat window, your defense is displayed as DEF. Two numerical values are shown, and the second number reflects the addition to your defense by your VIT.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
让我们来看看防御力。
在你的状态窗口中，防御力显示为DEF。显示两个数值，第二个数值反映了体质对你防御力的加成。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Now, the first number
displayed in your Defense is the defense calculated from your Equipment and Armor.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
现在，防御力显示的第一个数值
是由你的装备和护甲计算得出的防御力。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Now, the equipment you wear reduces damage from enemies by a percentage of the total damage, where VIT reduces by a set amount. That's why Defense is displayed with two numbers.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
你穿戴的装备按总伤害的百分比减少敌人造成的伤害，而体质则是减少固定数值的伤害。这就是为什么防御力显示两个数值。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
The next subject
is Intelligence (INT).
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
下一个主题
是智力 (INT)。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
INT affects your maximum amount of ^4D4DFFSP^000000, ^4D4DFFSP restoration^000000, the ^4D4DFF damage of your magic attack (MATK)^000000 and your ^4D4DFFdefense against magic attack (MDEF)^000000.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
智力影响你的最大^4D4DFFSP^000000、^4D4DFFSP恢复量^000000、^4D4DFF魔法攻击伤害 (MATK)^000000以及^4D4DFF魔法防御力 (MDEF)^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
The SP amount and MATK increased
by 1 INT is dependent on Job Class, just like VIT. This means that some Jobs will naturally benefit more from having more INT than others.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
每增加1点智力所提升的SP量和MATK值取决于职业，就像体质一样。这意味着某些职业会比其他职业更受益于高智力。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Just like normal DEF, your Magic Defense (MDEF) shows as 2 different numerical values. The MDEF contributed by INT is the second MDEF value displayed.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
就像普通防御力一样，你的魔法防御力 (MDEF) 也显示为两个不同的数值。由智力贡献的MDEF是显示的第二个MDEF数值。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
In order to study manipulation of the natural elements, you should prioritize on having intelligence. Therefore, Sages and Wizards
focus on the INT stat.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
为了研究自然元素的操控，你应该优先提升智力。因此，贤者和巫师都专注于提升智力属性。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Our last subject
is Dexterity (DEX)
and Luck (LUK).
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
我们最后一个主题是敏捷 (DEX) 和幸运 (LUK)。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Dexterity mainly affects your accuracy, attack speed (ASPD)
and your average attack strength.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
敏捷主要影响你的命中率、攻击速度 (ASPD) 以及你的平均攻击力。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Let me explain...
If you have low DEX, the difference between the minimum damage and
the maximum damage you can inflict becomes huge. The damage of your attacks becomes unstable.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
让我解释一下...
如果你的敏捷较低，你能造成的最小伤害和最大伤害之间的差距就会变得很大。你的攻击伤害会变得不稳定。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
If you are using a ^4D4DFFBow^000000 as your
main weapon, your attack strength will be based on^4D4DFFDEX^000000. So Archers should focus on increasing their DEX.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
如果你使用^4D4DFF弓^000000作为主武器，你的攻击力将基于^4D4DFF敏捷^000000。所以弓箭手应该专注于提升敏捷。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
The amount of DEX that you
have will also affect your attack accuracy. Attack accuracy is calculated by the number of your Base Level added to your DEX.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
你拥有的敏捷值也会影响你的攻击命中率。攻击命中率是通过你的基础等级加上敏捷值计算得出的。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
For example, if you are at
Base Level 40 and have 20 DEX,
your attack accuracy would be 60.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
例如，如果你的基础等级是40，敏捷是20，那么你的攻击命中率就是60。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Finally, DEX also reduces the casting time of spells and skills. Therefore, having some DEX would
be handy for Mages and Wizards.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
最后，敏捷还能减少法术和技能的吟唱时间。因此，魔法师和巫师拥有一些敏捷会很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Now, let me tell
you about the LUK stat.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
现在，让我告诉你关于幸运属性的事。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Luck (LUK) affects the chance
for a critical attack, the Flee Rate and a small amount of damage you deal to monsters.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
幸运 (LUK) 影响暴击几率、移花接木几率以及你对魔物造成的一小部分伤害。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
For a critical attack, the start value is 1 for everyone and it's increased by^4d4dff 1^000000 for every ^4d4dff3 LUK^000000.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
对于暴击攻击，每个人的起始值是1，并且每^4d4dff3点幸运^000000增加^4d4dff 1^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
With more LUK, you have an increased change of inflicting ^3355FFcritical attacks^000000 to your enemies. Critical attacks are useful to you, as they pierce your enemy's defense.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
幸运越高，你对敌人造成^3355FF暴击攻击^000000的几率就越大。暴击攻击对你很有用，因为它们能穿透敌人的防御。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
You can tell you've performed a critical attack when an attack has inflicted more damage than usual to an enemy, and the damage number is displayed with an explosive red visual effect.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
当一次攻击对敌人造成的伤害高于平时，且伤害数字以爆炸性的红色视觉效果显示时，你就知道发生了暴击攻击。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
For every 10 LUK, you add 1 point to your Perfect Dodge rate. Perfect Dodge is sort of like your Flee Rate. When you perform a Perfect Dodge, the word '^FF7F00Lucky^000000' will appear over your head.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
每10点幸运，你的完美闪避率增加1点。完美闪避有点像你的移花接木。当你进行完美闪避时，你的头顶会出现'^FF7F00拉基^000000'字样。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Although similar to your Flee Rate, Perfect Dodge is a separate factor in attack evasion that is calculated differently.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
虽然与移花接木相似，但完美闪避是攻击回避中一个独立的因素，其计算方式不同。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Well, I must say,
Luck is a good thing to have, but that doesn't mean you need it before everything else.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
嗯，我必须说，幸运是一件好事，但这并不意味着你需要把它放在其他一切之前。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Do you have any
other questions?
I hope my class
was helpful to you.
scripts.translation:
[亚雷·里奥特]
你还有其他问题吗？
希望我的课对你有所帮助。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Welcome~
Oh look at this
cute little Novice~!
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
欢迎~
哦，看看这个可爱的初心者~！

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
I, Leo Handerson,
feel so responsible for your performance and will be teaching you to the best of my ability. Now, please select the subject you wish to learn.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
我，里奥·汉德森，对你们的表现深感责任重大，并将尽我所能进行教导。现在，请选择您想学习的科目。

scripts.text: Passive and Active skills
scripts.translation: 被动与主动技能

scripts.text: Basic Skills
scripts.translation: 基本技能

scripts.text: Use of Emoticons
scripts.translation: 表情符号的使用

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
First, let me explain
about the Passive Skills.
Would please you open
your Skill Window?
('^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFS^000000')
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
首先，让我解释一下被动技能。
请打开您的技能窗口。
（'^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFS^000000'）

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Now, you know that whenever
your Job Level goes up, you earn
a ^3355FFSkill Point^000000, right? Skill Points are used to learn your skills~
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
现在，你知道每当你的职业等级提升时，都会获得一个^3355FF技能点^000000，对吧？技能点用于学习你的技能~

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Do you see your Basic Skill icon? It's at the very top of the Skill Window. Click on the 'Lv Up' button next to the Basic Skill icon to use a Skill Point on Basic Skills.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
你看到你的基本技能图标了吗？它位于技能窗口的最顶端。点击基本技能图标旁边的“Lv Up”按钮，即可使用技能点提升基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
You'll see to the word 'Passive'
to the right of the Basic Skill icon. That means this skill is Passive, and doesn't use any SP.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
你会看到基本技能图标右侧有“被动”字样。这意味着该技能是被动技能，不消耗SP。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Now, please right-click the Basic Skill icon. You will then be able to read a brief description of the Basic Skills.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
现在，请右键点击基本技能图标。然后你就可以阅读基本技能的简要描述了。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Active Skills, unlike Passive Skills which don't use any SP, require SP each time that
they are used.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
主动技能与不消耗SP的被动技能不同，每次使用都需要消耗SP。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
You can use an Active Skill by double-clicking its icon in your Skill Window.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
你可以双击技能窗口中的图标来使用主动技能。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
You can also drag a skill icon from your Skill Window, and drop it into your Hotkey bar ('^3355FFF12^000000' key) to assign a Hotkey to that skill.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
你也可以将技能图标从技能窗口拖拽到快捷栏（'^3355FFF12^000000'键）中，为该技能分配快捷键。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
The amount of SP required
to use an Active Skill will be displayed to the right of that skill's icon.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
使用主动技能所需的SP数量将显示在该技能图标的右侧。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Generally, Passive Skills are skills related to mental or physical training and conditioning. The use of special abilities or attacks are Active Skills.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
通常来说，被动技能是与精神或身体训练和调理相关的技能。而使用特殊能力或攻击则属于主动技能。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
If you're still not
sure about my lesson,
I'm willing to go over
it once again.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
如果你对我的课程仍有任何疑问，
我很乐意再讲解一遍。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
The Basic Skills are
purely Passive Skills
that you need to play
Ragnarok Online.
Don't worry,
they're easy to learn.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
基本技能是纯粹的被动技能，
是游玩《仙境传说》所必需的。
别担心，
它们很容易学习。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
When you right-click with your mouse in your Skill Window
('^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFS^000000'), you can check the descriptions of the skills, but I've prepared this lesson for
your better understanding.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
在技能窗口中右键点击（'^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFS^000000'），你可以查看技能描述，但我准备了这堂课以便你更好地理解。

scripts.text: Trade and Exchange
scripts.translation: 交易与交换

scripts.text: Organizing & Joining party
scripts.translation: 组建与加入队伍

scripts.text: Opening Chat Room
scripts.translation: 打开聊天室

scripts.text: Storage Use
scripts.translation: 使用仓库

scripts.text: No thanks, I know this already.
scripts.translation: 不用了，我已经知道了。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
When you go visit our official website at ^0000FFiro.ragnarokonline.com^000000, you can find a full explanation about trading, illustrated with pictures.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
访问我们的官方网站 ^0000FFiro.ragnarokonline.com^000000，你可以找到关于交易的完整说明，并配有图片。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
In order to trade items
or zeny with other people,
you must learn at least ^3355FFBasic Skill Level 1^000000.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
为了与其他玩家交易物品或Zeny，你必须至少学习 ^3355FF基本技能等级 1^000000。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
When you trade, you must be
located close to the person with which you wish to exchange items or zeny. Otherwise, the trade will not work if that person is more than 2 cells away.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
进行交易时，你必须靠近想要交换物品或Zeny的玩家。否则，如果对方距离超过2格，交易将无法进行。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Right-click on the person
once and a small menu will appear.
From this menu, choose:
^800fffRequest a deal with^000000.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
右键点击对方一次，会出现一个小菜单。
从菜单中选择：
^800fff请求交易^000000。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Afterwards, that person will
choose whether or not to accept your request. If your trade request is accepted, the Trade Window will appear.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
之后，对方将选择是否接受你的请求。如果交易请求被接受，交易窗口将会出现。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
To trade items, drag items from your Inventory Window ('^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFE^000000') and drop them into the left side of the Trade Window.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
要交易物品，请将物品从物品栏窗口（'^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFE^000000'）拖拽并放置在交易窗口的左侧。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Items given by the other person will appear in the right side of the Trade Window. Always check
if the other person is trading the items you have agreed to exchange.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
对方给出的物品会出现在交易窗口的右侧。请始终检查对方是否正在交易你们约定交换的物品。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
To trade Zeny, you can enter the amount of Zeny you want to trade. After placing items or Zeny into the Trade Window, press the 'OK' button at the bottom of the Window to confirm the trade.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
要交易Zeny，你可以输入想要交易的Zeny数量。将物品或Zeny放入交易窗口后，按下窗口底部的“OK”按钮以确认交易。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Once the trade is confirmed,
press the 'Trade' button to finish the trade. If either of the traders do not press the 'OK' button, the trade cannot be completed.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
交易确认后，按下“交易”按钮以完成交易。如果任何一方都没有按下“OK”按钮，交易将无法完成。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
If either of the traders presses the 'Cancel' button to the right of the window, the trade will be cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
如果任何一方按下窗口右侧的“取消”按钮，交易将被取消。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Now, let me explain
about the Party System.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
现在，让我来解释一下队伍系统。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
The Party system allows
you to organize a small group with people in order to cooperatively hunt monsters, or just to have fun together.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
队伍系统允许你组织一个小团体，以便合作狩猎魔物，或者只是在一起玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
You can organize
a party by typing
the command:
^4F4FFF//organize ''Party Name''^000000
in your Chat Window.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
你可以在聊天窗口中输入以下命令来组建队伍：
^4F4FFF//organize ''队伍名称''^000000

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Of course, you
must be at least
^4d4dffBasic Skill Level 7^000000
or above to use the Party System.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
当然，你必须至少达到
^4d4dff基本技能等级 7^000000
才能使用队伍系统。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
I could explain more about
the distribution of items or the distribution of experience which party members have gained together, but it's that you try that out on your own later on.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
我可以进一步解释物品分配或队伍成员共同获得的经验值分配，但建议你之后自己尝试一下。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
That's all for
the Party System~
An adorable Novice
like you should pick
on this really quickly~
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
关于队伍系统就讲到这里~
像你这样可爱的初心者
应该能很快掌握~

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
When you have
^4D4DFFLevel 4 Basic Skill^000000
or above, you can open your own Chat Room. You can either click
the ^3355FFchat^000000 button in the Basic Info Window or just press '^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFC^000000.'
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
当你拥有
^4D4DFF等级 4 基本技能^000000
或更高时，你可以打开自己的聊天室。你可以点击基本信息窗口中的 ^3355FF聊天^000000 按钮，或者直接按下 '^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFC^000000'。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Once you open a Chat Room,
you can check the chat room members' information by right-clicking on a character name.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
打开聊天室后，你可以右键点击角色名称来查看聊天室成员的信息。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Also you can register that character as your friend in the same way. If you are the master
of the room, you can change
the room setup.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
同样，你也可以用同样的方式将该角色添加为好友。如果你是房间的主人，还可以更改房间设置。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
While in the Chat Room,
you cannot hear any chat from outside of the Chat Room. Please remember that, okay?
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
在聊天室中，你无法听到聊天室外部的对话。请牢记这一点，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Kafra Employees of the
Kafra Corporation are scattered throughout the world, providing their convenient services and Storage.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
卡普拉总公司的卡普拉 职员遍布世界各地，为您提供便捷的服务和仓库。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
In fact, there's a Kafra Employee just outside of this room. Talk to her, and she'll be more than happy to fully explain Kafra's Services.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
事实上，就在这个房间外面就有一位卡普拉 职员。和她对话，她会非常乐意为您详细介绍卡普拉的服务。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Anyway, you are
allowed to use your
^4d4dffpersonal Kafra Storage^000000
at ^4D4DFFBasic Skill Level 6^000000 or above.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
总之，当您的
^4d4dff基本技能等级达到 6^000000
或更高时，就可以使用您的
^4d4dff个人卡普拉仓库^000000
了。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
When you carry too many items with you, your weight becomes too heavy and you won't be able to restore HP or SP by resting, or even fight monsters! So store what you don't need into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
如果您携带的物品过多，负重会变得太重，导致您无法通过休息恢复HP或SP，甚至无法战斗！所以请将不需要的物品存入卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Oh, do you?
As I expected,
you're as smart
as you are cute~!
I, Leo, am very impressed.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
哦，是吗？
正如我所料，
你既聪明又可爱~！
我，里奥，对此印象深刻。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Do you wish to
learn more about
a different subject?
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
您想学习
关于其他主题的
更多知识吗？

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
^4d4dffEmoticons^000000 are commonly used
online for ^4D4DFFdisplaying your feelings^000000. It's a fun way of communicating!
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
^4d4dff表情符号^000000
通常用于在线
^4D4DFF表达您的情感^000000
。这是一种有趣的交流方式！

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
You must first be at
^4D4DFFBasic Skill Level 2^000000
or above to use emoticons.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
您必须首先达到
^4D4DFF基本技能等级 2^000000
或更高才能使用表情符号。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
You can check the
Emotion icon List
('^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFL^000000') and click each icon to see the command to display
the emoticon.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
您可以查看
表情图标列表
（'^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFL^000000'），点击每个图标即可查看显示该表情符号的命令。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
You can also register
emoticons into your Shortcut List ('^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFM^000000') so you can just use a Shortcut to use an emoticon. This is also fully explained on our official website as well.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
您还可以将表情符号注册到快捷列表（'^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFM^000000'）中，这样只需使用快捷键即可发送表情符号。我们的官方网站上也有详细说明。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Ah~ I must say,
the honest expression
of one's feelings is essential
for a relationship.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
啊~ 我必须说，
真诚地表达自己的情感
对于建立关系至关重要。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
You can play
Rock, Paper, Scissors
by pressing the '^4D4DFFCtrl^000000' and the '^4D4DFF - ^000000,' '^4D4DFF = ^000000,' or '^4D4DFF \ ^000000' keys.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
您可以按下'^4D4DFFCtrl^000000'键和'^4D4DFF - ^000000'、'^4D4DFF = ^000000'或'^4D4DFF \ ^000000'键来玩石头剪刀布。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Of course, you can type ^4D4DFF//bawi^000000, ^4D4DFF//bo^000000 and ^4D4DFF//gawi^000000, which mean rock, paper, scissors in Korean, into your Chat Window.
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
当然，您也可以输入^4D4DFF//bawi^000000、^4D4DFF//bo^000000和^4D4DFF//gawi^000000，它们分别代表韩语中的石头、剪刀和布，到聊天窗口中。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
To check out the commands for even more emoticons, type the command ^4d4dff//emotion^000000 into your Chat Window to see the list~
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
要查看更多表情符号的命令，请在聊天窗口中输入命令^4d4dff//emotion^000000以查看列表~

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
I see...
You don't need me
anymore! Oh! They
grow up so fast
nowadays!
scripts.translation:
[里奥·汉德森]
我明白了...
你不需要我了！
哦！现在的孩子
长得真快啊！

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
We Guide Soldiers provide location information at the entrance of every town. You can easily find us by our special uniforms.
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
我们向导士兵在每个城镇的入口处提供位置信息。您可以通过我们特殊的制服轻松找到我们。

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
Whenever you visit a town
for the first time, we would like to recommend that you check the locations of notable places in town with us.
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
每次您第一次访问一个城镇时，我们建议您与我们一起查看城镇中重要地点的位置。

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
If you wish to take an Informative class, please walk around and speak to the various tutors in these Training Grounds. Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
如果您想上资讯课，请四处走动并与这些训练场中的各种导师对话。祝您愉快。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Congratulations!
You have passed the 1st training course! Wow~ I guess now you understand a little bit more about Ragnarok Online.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
恭喜！
你通过了第一阶段的训练课程！哇~ 我想你现在对《仙境传说》有了一些更深的了解。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
You will learn the fundamentals of actual battle through this class. If you did your best through the Informative class, you are supposed to have been given some starting equipment.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
在这节课中，你将学习实战的基础知识。如果你在资讯课上表现良好，应该已经获得了一些初始装备。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Please check your
equipment before you engaging in battle. Are you sure you've equipped all of your equipment, your weapons and armor?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
在投入战斗之前，请检查你的装备。你确定已经装备了所有的物品、武器和防具吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
First, you place the cursor on a monster. When you left click, you will hit the monster once.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
首先，将光标放在魔物身上。当你点击鼠标左键时，你会攻击魔物一次。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
If you are too lazy to keep left clicking, left click on the monster while holding the '^4D4DFFCtrl^000000' key. You will then continue attacking the monster until one of you is dead, or you run away.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
如果你懒得一直按鼠标左键，可以在按住'^4D4DFFCtrl^000000'键的同时点击魔物。这样你会持续攻击魔物，直到其中一方死亡，或者你逃跑为止。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
You can also just hold down the left mouse button while the cursor is on the monster. Still, there are some people who are even too lazy to use the '^4D4DFFCtrl^000000' key every time they attack a monster.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
你也可以在光标位于魔物身上时，按住鼠标左键不放。不过，有些人甚至懒得每次攻击魔物都使用'^4D4DFFCtrl^000000'键。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
If you're one of them, type the command ^E79E29//nc^000000 in your Chat Window. Then, when you left click
a monster, you'll just continuously attack it!
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
如果你也是其中之一，请在聊天窗口中输入命令^E79E29//nc^000000。这样，当你点击魔物时，你就会持续攻击它！

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
If a monster happens to have the Undead property, you can use the 'Heal' skill to attack if you happen to have it.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
如果魔物恰好拥有不死属性，而你又拥有'治愈术'技能，你可以使用它来攻击。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
When you use the Heal skill while holding down the '^4D4DFFShift^000000' key, you can target the monster with the Heal skill to damage it.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
当你在按住'^4D4DFFShift^000000'键时使用治愈术，你可以将目标锁定在魔物身上以对其造成伤害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Of course for this skill, we do have a very convenient option for lazy people too. Type the command ^E79E29//ns^000000 in your Chat Window.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
当然，对于这项技能，我们也为懒人准备了一个非常方便的功能。请在聊天窗口中输入命令^E79E29//ns^000000。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
This will allow you to attack monsters by using the Heal skill without holding the shift key. Handy, huh?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
这将允许你使用治愈术攻击魔物，而无需按住Shift键。很方便吧？

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Do you understand these battle commands? Now, I will teaching you about monster behaviors and properties, experience gained through battle, and items you can earn from dead monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
你理解这些战斗指令了吗？现在，我将教你关于魔物的行为和属性、通过战斗获得的经验值，以及从死亡的魔物身上可以获得的物品。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Field Combat Training can be actually be pretty dangerous for new adventurers. Let me give you
a little more strength through the power of my magic.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
野外战斗训练对新手冒险者来说可能相当危险。让我用我的魔力为你增加一点力量。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Haaaaaaa~!
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
哈啊啊啊~！

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Which subject
should I cover
first for you?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
你想先了解哪个主题？

scripts.text: Monsters
scripts.translation: 魔物

scripts.text: Experience
scripts.translation: <黑暗搜集者>经验值

scripts.text: Items
scripts.translation: 物品

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
There are many aggressive monsters that will attack you first before you even approach them.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
有许多具有攻击性的魔物，它们会在你靠近之前先攻击你。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
There are also a few monsters that will cooperate with others of their kind. Attack one of them, and the whole pack of them will swarm around you, seeking revenge.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
也有一些魔物会与同类合作。攻击其中一个，它们整个群体就会围上来，寻求复仇。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Every monster can be specified by their types, sizes and properties. For example, there are Demi-human, Brute, Holy and Demon property monsters out there.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
每种魔物都可以通过其类型、大小和属性来区分。例如，那里有半人型、野兽型、神圣型和恶魔型属性的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
When you're aware of what property a monster is, you can use that knowledge to help you in battle.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
当你了解魔物的属性后，就可以利用这些知识来辅助战斗。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
If you manage to get cards for that increase your damage upon certain monster properties, or reduce damage from specific monster properties, you'll have a much easier time in battle.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
如果你能获取增加对特定属性魔物伤害，或减少来自特定属性魔物伤害的卡片，战斗将会轻松许多。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Monsters are separated by their size: small, medium and large. There are a few cards that allow you to do more damage to
a specific monster size.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
魔物按大小分为小型、中型和大型。有一些卡片可以让你对特定大小的魔物造成更多伤害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Also, each weapon has its strengths and weaknesses. The size of the weapon will affect the damage it will deal to monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
此外，每种武器都有其强项和弱项。武器的大小会影响它对魔物造成的伤害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
For example, Dagger class weapons do 100 % damage on small sized monsters but only inflict 50 % on large monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
例如，短剑类武器对小型魔物造成100%的伤害，但对大型魔物只造成50%的伤害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Common monster properties include Water, Wind, Earth, Fire, Shadow, Ghost and Holy. If you attack a monster with an opposing property, you can inflict additional damage~
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
常见的魔物属性包括水、风、地、火、暗、幽灵和神圣。如果你用相克属性的攻击去攻击魔物，可以造成额外伤害~

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
But if you attack a monster with
a skill or weapon that inflicts damage of the same property as the monster, the damage will be greatly reduced, or completely negated. You might even heal the monster!
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
但是，如果你用与魔物属性相同的技能或武器攻击它，伤害会大幅降低，甚至完全无效。你甚至可能会治疗魔物！

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
In the case of Ghost property monsters, normal weapons cannot do any harm. However, a weapon with any other property will be able to deal out some damage.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
对于幽灵属性的魔物，普通武器无法造成伤害。然而，具有其他属性的武器可以对其造成一定伤害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Basically, a character who deals the most damage on a monster receives the most experience points from the monster.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
基本上，对魔物造成伤害最多的角色，会从该魔物身上获得最多的经验值。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Therefore, you receive a certain percentage of experience points in proportion to the damage you've inflicted on the monster, compared to its total HP.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
因此，你获得的经验值比例，取决于你对魔物造成的伤害与其总HP的比例。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Let's say, there is a character named 'Z.' Z does 65 damage on a monster that has 100 total HP and gives 1000 experience points when it's dead. So, Z will receive 650 experience points.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
假设有一个叫'Z.'的角色。Z对一只总HP为100、死亡时提供1000经验值的魔物造成了65点伤害。那么，Z将获得650点经验值。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
However, this rule applies differently following certain situations.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
不过，在某些情况下，这条规则会有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
If there are two people who both did 65 damage on the same monster, the experience points that each will receive differs, depending on the monster's remaining HP.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
如果有两个人都对同一只魔物造成了65点伤害，他们各自获得的经验值会根据魔物剩余的HP而有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
For instance, somebody does damage to a monster while you're already hitting it, and he did the same amount of damage you did.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
例如，当你正在攻击一只魔物时，另一个人也对其造成了伤害，且伤害量与你相同。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
In this case, you will receive 2//3 of the whole experience points that monster can give you, the other one will receive 1//3.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
在这种情况下，你将获得该魔物总经验值的2/3，而另一个人将获得1/3。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
However, attacking a monster that somebody already started to hit is not suggested in Ragnarok Online. That action is regarded as ill-mannered behavior.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
然而，在《仙境传说》中，不建议攻击别人已经开始攻击的魔物。这种行为被视为不礼貌。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
For party play, the party master can set the experience distribution to the equally share option.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
在队伍游戏中，队伍长可以将经验分配设置为“平均分配”选项。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
With this method, party members can share their experience according to the their character levels, and the number of members in the party.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
通过这种方式，队伍成员可以根据他们的角色等级和队伍中的人数来分享经验值。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Also, there is the experience benefit for party play which allows you to gain more experience points than playing solo. You can take advantage of this system for faster leveling.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
此外，队伍游戏还有经验加成，允许你获得比单人游戏更多的经验值。你可以利用这个系统来更快升级。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
When you kill monsters,
you can obtain items by chance. Furthermore, certain characters can use the 'Steal' skill in order to steal items from monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
当你击杀魔物时，有机会获得物品。此外，某些角色可以使用<偷窃>技能从魔物身上偷取物品。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Don't you worry about the Steal skill causing you to not find any items after you kill them. Using the Steal skill does not at all affect the item drop rate for monsters once they're killed.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
不用担心使用<偷窃>技能会导致击杀魔物后无法掉落物品。使用<偷窃>技能完全不会影响魔物被击杀后的物品掉落率。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
When a group of people kill a monster, the person who did the most damage receives priority in picking up item drops.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
当一群人共同击杀一只魔物时，造成最高伤害的人拥有拾取掉落物品的优先权。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Feel free to
ask me if you
have any questions.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
如果您有任何问题，请随时向我提问。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Please take care of the equipment you've received through the training courses. Once you lose the equipment, you can never get them back.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
请妥善保管您在训练课程中获得的装备。一旦丢失，将无法再次获得。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Which subject
shall I expain?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
您想了解哪方面的内容？

scripts.text: Monsters
scripts.translation: 魔物

scripts.text: Experience
scripts.translation: <黑暗搜集者>经验值

scripts.text: Items
scripts.translation: 物品

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
There are many aggressive monsters that will attack you first before you even approach them.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
有许多具有攻击性的魔物，它们会在你靠近之前先攻击你。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
There are also a few monsters that will cooperate with others of their kind. Attack one of them, and the whole pack of them will swarm around you, seeking revenge.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
也有一些魔物会与同类合作。攻击其中一个，它们整个群体就会围上来，寻求复仇。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Every monster can be specified by their types, sizes and properties. For example, there are Demi-human, Brute, Holy and Demon property monsters out there.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
每种魔物都可以通过其类型、大小和属性来区分。例如，那里有半人型、野兽型、神圣型和恶魔型属性的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
When you're aware of what property a monster is, you can use that knowledge to help you in battle.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
当你了解魔物的属性后，就可以利用这些知识来辅助战斗。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
If you manage to get cards for that increase your damage upon certain monster properties, or reduce damage from specific monster properties, you'll have a much easier time in battle.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
如果你能获取增加对特定属性魔物伤害，或减少来自特定属性魔物伤害的卡片，战斗将会轻松许多。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Monsters are separated by their size: small, medium and large. There are a few cards that allow you to do more damage to a specific monster size.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
魔物按体型分为小型、中型和大型。有一些卡片可以增加您对特定体型魔物的伤害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Also, each weapon has its strengths and weaknesses. The size of the weapon will affect the damage it will deal to monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
此外，每种武器都有其强项和弱项。武器的大小会影响它对魔物造成的伤害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
For example, Dagger class weapons do 100 % damage on small sized monsters but only inflict 50 % on large monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
例如，短剑类武器对小型魔物造成100%的伤害，但对大型魔物只造成50%的伤害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Common monster properties include Water, Wind, Earth, Fire, Shadow, Ghost and Holy. If you attack a monster with an opposing property, you can inflict additional damage~
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
常见的魔物属性包括水、风、地、火、暗、幽灵和神圣。如果你用相克属性的攻击去攻击魔物，可以造成额外伤害~

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
But if you attack a monster with
a skill or weapon that inflicts damage of the same property as the monster, the damage will be greatly reduced, or completely negated. You might even heal the monster!
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
但是，如果你用与魔物属性相同的技能或武器攻击它，伤害会大幅降低，甚至完全无效。你甚至可能会治疗魔物！

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
In the case of Ghost property monsters, normal weapons cannot do any harm. However, a weapon with any other property will be able to deal out some damage.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
对于幽灵属性的魔物，普通武器无法造成伤害。然而，具有其他属性的武器可以对其造成一定伤害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Basically, a character who deals the most damage on a monster receives the most experience points from the monster.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
基本上，对魔物造成伤害最多的角色，会从该魔物身上获得最多的经验值。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Therefore, you receive a certain percentage of experience points in proportion to the damage you've inflicted on the monster, compared to its total HP.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
因此，你获得的经验值比例，取决于你对魔物造成的伤害与其总HP的比例。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Let's say, there is a character named 'Z.' Z does 65 damage on a monster that has 100 total HP and gives 1000 experience points when it's dead. So, Z will receive 650 experience points.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
假设有一个叫'Z.'的角色。Z对一只总HP为100、死亡时提供1000经验值的魔物造成了65点伤害。那么，Z将获得650点经验值。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
However, this rule applies differently following certain situations.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
不过，在某些情况下，这条规则会有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
If there are two people who both did 65 damage on the same monster, the experience points that each will receive differs, depending on the monster's remaining HP.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
如果有两个人都对同一只魔物造成了65点伤害，他们各自获得的经验值会根据魔物剩余的HP而有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
For instance, somebody does damage to a monster while you're already hitting it, and he did the same amount of damage you did.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
例如，当你正在攻击一只魔物时，另一个人也对其造成了伤害，且伤害量与你相同。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
In this case, you will receive 2//3 of the whole experience points that monster can give you, the other one will receive 1//3.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
在这种情况下，你将获得该魔物总经验值的2/3，而另一个人将获得1/3。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
However, attacking a monster that somebody already started to hit is not suggested in Ragnarok Online. That action is regarded as ill-mannered behavior.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
然而，在《仙境传说》中，不建议攻击别人已经开始攻击的魔物。这种行为被视为不礼貌。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
For party play, the party master can set the experience distribution to the equally share option.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
在队伍游戏中，队伍长可以将经验分配设置为“平均分配”选项。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
With this method, party members can share their experience according to the their character levels, and the number of members in the party.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
通过这种方式，队伍成员可以根据他们的角色等级和队伍中的人数来分享经验值。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Also, there is the experience benefit for party play which allows you to gain more experience points than playing solo. You can take advantage of this system for faster leveling.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
此外，队伍游戏还有经验加成，允许你获得比单人游戏更多的经验值。你可以利用这个系统来更快升级。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
When you kill monsters,
you can obtain items by chance. Furthermore, certain characters can use the 'Steal' skill in order to steal items from monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
当你击杀魔物时，有机会获得物品。此外，某些角色可以使用<偷窃>技能从魔物身上偷取物品。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Don't you worry about the Steal skill causing you to not find any items after you kill them. Using the Steal skill does not at all affect the item drop rate for monsters once they're killed.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
不用担心使用<偷窃>技能会导致击杀魔物后无法掉落物品。使用<偷窃>技能完全不会影响魔物被击杀后的物品掉落率。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
When a group of people kill a monster, the person who did the most damage receives priority in picking up item drops.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
当一群人共同击杀一只魔物时，造成最高伤害的人拥有拾取掉落物品的优先权。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Feel free to
ask me if you
have any questions.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔敏]
如果您有任何问题，请随时向我提问。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
I'm sorry, but I can't let anybody who hasn't been instructed on fighting enter the Field Combat Training Grounds.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尔]
很抱歉，我不能让没有接受过战斗指导的人进入野外战斗训练场。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Why don't you speak to the Helper to the left side of this room first, so that you can receive some battle instruction?
scripts.translation:
[穆里尔]
您不妨先和这个房间左边的助手对话，接受一些战斗指导？

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Field Combat Training is an actual fight class where you can gain basic fighting skills that you can use to defend yourself in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尔]
野外战斗训练是一堂实战课，您可以获得用于在米德加尔特自卫的基础战斗技能。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Please kill as many monsters as you can to increase your base level at least 2 times.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尔]
请尽可能多地击杀魔物，将您的基础等级至少提升2级。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Gaining 2 base levels is required to complete your Field Combat Training. Although the monsters are all weak and easy to kill, I hope you will be careful.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尔]
提升2级基础等级是完成野外战斗训练的必要条件。虽然这些魔物都很弱且容易击杀，但我希望您能小心行事。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Do you wish
to take the test
right away?
scripts.translation:
[穆里尔]
您希望立即进行测试吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: I need more time.
scripts.translation: 我需要更多时间。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Please make sure you
talk to the staff at the North after you increase your base level by 2 levels through battle.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尔]
请确保在通过战斗将基础等级提升2级后，与北边的职员对话。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
I'm going to give you some useful supplies, so please use them in case of an emergency.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尔]
我会给您一些有用的补给品，请在紧急情况下使用它们。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
No problem.
If you're not sure if you can pass the test or not, why don't you go talk to the Helper to the left one more time? Please come back
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尔]
没问题。
如果您不确定自己能否通过测试，不妨再去和左边的助手对话一次？
请准备好后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Oh well, I told you to be careful. Cheer up! It's not a big deal.
 
Failure teaches success.
You have many chances
to re-take the test.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尔]
好吧，我早就告诉过你要小心了。振作起来！这没什么大不了的。

失败是成功之母。
您有很多机会重新测试。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Do you wish
to try again?
scripts.translation:
[穆里尔]
您希望再试一次吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Can I have more time?
scripts.translation: 我可以多要一些时间吗？

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
I will give you
some supplies again.
Please be careful!
scripts.translation:
[穆里尔]
我会再给您一些补给品。
请小心！

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
No problem.
If you're not sure if you can pass the test or not, why don't you go talk to the Helper to the left one more time? Please come back
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尔]
没问题。
如果您不确定自己能否通过测试，不妨再去和左边的助手对话一次？
请准备好后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Oh well, I told you to be careful. Cheer up! It's not a big deal.
 
Failure teaches success.
You have many chances to re-take the test.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尔]
唉，我早就让你小心了。振作点！没什么大不了的。

失败是成功之母。
你还有很多机会重新参加测试。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Do you wish to try again?
scripts.translation:
[穆里尔]
您希望再试一次吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: Can I have more time?
scripts.translation: 我可以多要一些时间吗？

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
I will restore
your HP. Please
be careful!
scripts.translation:
[穆里尔]
我会恢复您的HP。
请小心！

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
No problem.
If you're not sure if you can pass the test or not, why don't you go talk to the Helper to the left one more time? Please come back when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尔]
没问题。
如果您不确定自己能否通过测试，不妨再去和左边的助手对话一次？
请准备好后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Hoffman]
Hey there~
I'm here to provide
you with a little instruction.
scripts.translation:
[霍夫曼]
嘿~
我来给你一点指导。

scripts.text:
[Hoffman]
These monsters are all weak
and easy to kill. But be careful,
a lot of them are aggressive
and out for blood!
scripts.translation:
[霍夫曼]
这些魔物都很弱，很容易就能打败。但小心点，
它们大多具有攻击性，而且很凶猛！

scripts.text:
[Hoffman]
If you think monsters here are too weak for you, I can send you to another training ground where the monsters are stronger than the ones over here.
scripts.translation:
[霍夫曼]
如果你觉得这里的魔物太弱了，我可以把你送到另一个训练场，那里的魔物比这里的更强。

scripts.text:
[Hoffman]
But don't worry so much,
They're not impossible for
Novices. So would you
like to try?
scripts.translation:
[霍夫曼]
不过别太担心，
它们对初心者来说并不是不可能战胜的。
那么，你想试试吗？

scripts.text: I do want more of a challenge~
scripts.translation: 我想接受更大的挑战~

scripts.text: I wanna fight tough monsters!
scripts.translation: 我想打更强的魔物！

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hoffman]
I see, then let me guide
you to a training ground that has stronger monsters. May God be with you...
scripts.translation:
[霍夫曼]
明白了，那么让我带你去一个魔物更强的训练场吧。愿上帝保佑你...

scripts.text:
[Hoffman]
You must like 
rough challenges,
don't you? Please
be careful, it can get
pretty difficult...
scripts.translation:
[霍夫曼]
看来你喜欢
激烈的挑战，
对吧？请小心，
那里可能会非常困难...

scripts.text:
[Hoffman]
Hmm...?
Are you worried about going
to more challenging places? That's understandable, since you're still a new adventurer. Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[霍夫曼]
嗯...？
你担心去更具挑战性的地方吗？这很正常，毕竟你还是个新冒险者。祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Keyman]
Good!!
Now you know how to fight
against monsters, don't you?
Would you like to move
to the next course?
scripts.translation:
[钥匙人]
很好！！
现在你知道如何与魔物战斗了，对吧？
你想进入下一关吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Keyman]
I hope you will be
a good fighter in the
future. Bon voyage.
scripts.translation:
[钥匙人]
希望你在未来
成为一名优秀的格斗家。
一路顺风。

scripts.text:
[Keyman]
I see...
It can't hurt to practice until you're more comfortable with the basics of battle.
scripts.translation:
[钥匙人]
我明白了...
在熟练掌握战斗基础之前，多练习一下也无妨。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
All of the items you are carrying must be quite a burden. Where did you get so much things? Please lighten your weight by getting rid of things you don't need.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
你携带的所有物品肯定是个不小的负担。你在哪里弄到这么多东西的？请丢弃不需要的物品来减轻负重。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Good day,
^A62A2A{0}'^000000.
You've made quite
an effort to come here.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
你好，
^A62A2A{0}^000000。
你来到这里
一定很不容易。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
This final test in the Training Grounds is a personality test,
but it's not a mandatory course.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
训练场的最后一项测试是性格测试，
但这不是必修课程。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
However, there are some benefits
to taking this test. When you take this test, you'll receive many health items which will help you when you join the Ragnarok Online community.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
不过，参加这项测试有一些好处。当你参加这项测试时，你会收到许多恢复物品，这将在你加入仙境传说社区时派上用场。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Secondly, after you finish the course we will suggest the job class that seems best suited to your personality and teleport you to a town where you can change into the job we suggested.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
其次，完成课程后，我们会根据测试结果推荐最适合你性格的职业，并将你传送到可以转职的城镇。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Now...
What would
you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
那么...
你想做什么？

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Do you wish to start Ragnarok Online immediately, or take this personality test course first?
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
你是想立即开始《仙境传说》，还是先参加这个性格测试课程？

scripts.text: I'll take the course.
scripts.translation: 我要参加课程。

scripts.text: Let me start Ragnarok Online please.
scripts.translation: 请让我开始《仙境传说》。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Excellent choice!
You're supposed to take every training course if you really want to be a well-prepared player!
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
很好的选择！
如果你真的想成为一名准备充分的玩家，就应该参加所有的培训课程！

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Alright, let me start the 1st personality test. Please relax
and take it easy.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
好的，让我开始第一项性格测试。请放松，
放轻松一点。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Remember, this test is only to check your personality, there is no set standard for right and wrong. Now! Let's begin the test!
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
记住，这个测试只是为了了解你的性格，没有绝对的对错之分。现在！让我们开始测试吧！

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Please choose the word
that best matches you from
among the following.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
请从以下选项中
选择最符合你性格的一个词。

scripts.text: Study
scripts.translation: 学习

scripts.text: Exercise
scripts.translation: 锻炼

scripts.text: Public service
scripts.translation: 公共服务

scripts.text: Violence
scripts.translation: 暴力

scripts.text: Change
scripts.translation: 改变

scripts.text: Conserve
scripts.translation: 保守

scripts.text: Consumer
scripts.translation: 消费者

scripts.text: Seller
scripts.translation: 卖家

scripts.text: Producer
scripts.translation: 生产者

scripts.text: Celebrity
scripts.translation: 名人

scripts.text: Prudence
scripts.translation: 谨慎

scripts.text: Theory
scripts.translation: 理论

scripts.text: Experience
scripts.translation: <黑暗搜集者>经验值

scripts.text: The Past
scripts.translation: 过去

scripts.text: Reality
scripts.translation: 现实

scripts.text: The Future
scripts.translation: 未来

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Please answer
'Yes' or 'No' to
the following questions.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
请对以下问题
回答“是”或“否”。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
I'd rather die
than live submissively.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
我宁愿死，
也不愿屈辱地活着。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You are often upset
to see someone better
than you.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
看到比你优秀的人，
你经常会感到不安。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You don't mind
exploring dangerous
places.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
你不介意
探索危险的地方。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You are
a leader-type
person.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
你是一个
具有领袖气质
的人。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
While exploring
a dungeon, you run
into a dead end.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
在探索地下城时，
你走进了一个死胡同。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
However, there is a sign that reads 'Do Not Push' next to a stone that looks strangely like a button on the wall next to you.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
然而，旁边有一块看起来像按钮的奇怪石头，
墙上还有一块写着“请勿触碰”的牌子。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Do you give in
to the urge to push
this button?
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
你会屈服于
按下这个按钮的
冲动吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You often see
things that don't exist.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
你经常看到
不存在的东西。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
If you fell off
a cliff, you'd feel
like you were flying.
scripts.translation:
[汉森]
如果你从悬崖上掉下来，
你会觉得自己
在飞翔。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Money talks.

scripts.text:

You are very warm hearted and considerate, and you're willing to sacrifice your well being for the sake of others.

You're always eager to help others, which is why you're so well liked.

For you who are kind of heart, ^696969Acolyte^000000 is the most suitable job.

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
As the name implies, the
Swordman is an expert in wielding Swords. They can also use Spear weapons, but typically you don't see Spear wielding Swordmen very often.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
顾名思义，剑士是擅长使用剑的专家。他们也可以使用长矛，但通常很少见到使用长矛的剑士。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Swordman possess strong physical strength, allowing them to equip heavy armor and weapons. Most weapon classes, except for bows and rods, can be equipped by the Swordman class.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
剑士拥有强大的体力，可以装备重型护甲和武器。除了弓和法杖外，剑士可以装备大多数类型的武器。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The only weakness of the Swordman class is that they cannot use magic spells. However, this can be compensated by using weapons with an elemental attribute.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
剑士唯一的弱点是无法使用魔法。不过，这可以通过使用带有属性攻击的武器来弥补。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
One of the greatest benefits of being a Swordman is having an enormous amount of HP, meaning they can more easily withstand damage from their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
成为剑士最大的优点之一是拥有大量的HP，这意味着他们能更轻松地承受敌人的攻击。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
After learning some strong attack skills, the Swordman is almost unbeatable in a melee fight.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在学习了一些强力攻击技能后，剑士在近战中几乎无人能敌。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
In Ragnarok Online, Swordman generally takes the position of tanker, protecting characters of other classes from being attacked or hurt.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在《仙境传说》中，剑士通常担任坦克的角色，保护其他职业的角色免受攻击或伤害。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
A Swordman is the ideal character to take the position of party leader. When advancing to the Second Job Class, Swordmen can change their jobs to ^8E2323Knights^000000 or ^8E2323Crusaders^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
剑士是担任队伍首领的理想人选。在转职为二转职业时，剑士可以转职为^8E2323骑士^000000或^8E2323十字军^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The Mage class specializes in using the forces of Fire, Water, Earth and Lightning to attack their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
魔法师职业擅长利用火、水、土和雷的力量攻击敌人。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
However, due to their weak physical strength, they are only allowed to equip Rods and Knives as weapons, and wear light armor for defense.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
然而，由于体力较弱，他们只能装备法杖和匕首作为武器，并穿着轻型护甲进行防御。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Despite their physical weakness, they are able to do massive damage with their powerful spells. This fact alone attracts many people to join this class.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
尽管体力较弱，但他们能凭借强大的法术造成巨额伤害。仅凭这一点就吸引了许多人选择这个职业。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
In Ragnarok Online, the Mage takes a heavily offensive role in parties and is depended upon to deal great damage to enemies.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在《仙境传说》中，魔法师在队伍中担任主要的输出角色，负责对敌人造成大量伤害。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
When advancing to the Second Job Class, Mages can change their jobs to ^8E2323Wizards^000000 or ^8E2323Sages^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在转职为二转职业时，魔法师可以转职为^8E2323巫师^000000或^8E2323贤者^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The Archer class are experts in using Bow weapons, and are useful in parties for their long range attacks.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
弓箭手职业是擅长使用弓的专家，在队伍中因其远程攻击能力而非常有用。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Despite being physically weaker, Archers possess high accuracy with powerful long range bows. This allows them to attack and kill monsters from a safe distance.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
尽管体力较弱，但弓箭手拥有极高的命中率和强大的远程弓。这使他们能够在安全的距离外攻击并击杀魔物。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
In Ragnarok Online, Archers have relatively little HP, but their long range attacks allow them to easily dispatch enemies before the enemy gets close enough to hurt them.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在《仙境传说》中，弓箭手的HP相对较少，但他们的远程攻击使他们能够在敌人靠近造成伤害之前轻松解决它们。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
When advancing to the Second Job Class, every Archer may advance to the ^8E2323Hunter^000000 class. Alternatively, male Archers may advance to become ^8E2323Bards^000000, and female Archers may become ^8E2323Dancers^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在转职为二转职业时，所有弓箭手都可以转职为^8E2323猎人^000000。或者，男性弓箭手可以转职为^8E2323诗人^000000，女性弓箭手可以转职为^8E2323舞娘^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The Merchant class specializes in commerce. Due to the strong influence of the Merchant Guild, the Merchant class is attractive to those who wish to focus on earning Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
商人职业擅长商业。由于商人公会的强大影响力，商人职业对希望专注于赚取Zeny的人来说很有吸引力。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
In Ragnarok Online, the Merchant class possesses various economic abilities. Merchants can learn to sell items to NPCs for higher prices, as well as receive discounts from NPCs.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在《仙境传说》中，商人职业拥有各种经济能力。商人可以学习以更高的价格向NPC出售物品，也可以从NPC处获得折扣。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
In addition, Merchants may rent
a Cart that greatly expands their carrying capacity and allows them to open shops with their own items and prices.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
此外，商人可以租用手推车，这极大地扩展了他们的携带容量，并允许他们用自己的物品和价格开设商店。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
When advancing to the Second Job Class, Merchants can change their jobs to ^8E2323Blacksmiths^000000 or ^8E2323Alchemists^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在转职为二转职业时，商人可以转职为^8E2323铁匠^000000或^8E2323炼金术士^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Thieves are experts at using Dagger class weapons. They strike quickly and easily evade attacks from their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
盗贼是短剑类武器的专家。他们出手迅速，并能轻松躲避敌人的攻击。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Thieves can learn skills that allow them to hide from their enemies, or steal items from monsters. They are also feared for their use of poison, which slowly weakens
their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
盗贼可以学习从敌人面前躲藏，或从魔物身上偷窃物品的技能。他们使用毒药的能力也令人畏惧，毒药会慢慢削弱敌人。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
When advancing to the Second Job Class, Thieves can change their jobs to ^8E2323Assassins^000000 or ^8E2323Rogues^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在转职为二转职业时，盗贼可以转职为^8E2323刺客^000000或^8E2323流氓^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
In Ragnarok Online, Acolytes act as messengers of God in Rune-Midgarts. They possess skills that support their allies, as well as the life saving Heal ability.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在《仙境传说》中，服事是卢恩·米德加兹的神之使者。他们拥有支援队友的技能，以及能救命的治愈术。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The Acolyte's support abilities make them a welcome addition to any party. In difficult situations, the Acolyte's skills will ensure the survival of the party, allowing other members to focus on offense.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
服事的支援能力使他们成为任何队伍中受欢迎的成员。在艰难的情况下，服事的技能将确保队伍的生存，让其他成员专注于进攻。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
When advancing to the Second Job Class, Acolytes can change their jobs to ^8E2323Priests^000000 or ^8E2323Monks^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在转职为二转职业时，服事可以转职为^8E2323牧师^000000或^8E2323武僧^000000。

For more information,
please visit the official
Ragnarok Online website:
 
^0000FFiro.ragnarokonline.com^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
如需更多信息，请访问《仙境传说》官方网站：

^0000FFiro.ragnarokonline.com^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
As the name implies, the
Swordman is an expert in wielding Swords. They can also use Spear weapons, but typically you don't see Spear wielding Swordmen
very often.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
顾名思义，剑士是擅长使用剑的专家。他们也可以使用长矛类武器，但通常很少见到使用长矛的剑士。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Swordmen possess strong physical strength, allowing them to equip heavy armor and weapons. Most weapon classes, except for bows and rods, can be equipped by the Swordman class.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
剑士拥有强大的体力，可以装备重型护甲和武器。除了弓和法杖外，剑士可以装备大多数武器类型。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The only weakness of the Swordman class is that they cannot use magic spells. However, this can be compensated by using weapons with an elemental attribute.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
剑士唯一的弱点是无法使用魔法。不过，这可以通过使用带有属性攻击的武器来弥补。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
One of the greatest benefits of being a Swordman is having an enormous amount of HP, meaning they can more easily withstand damage from their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
成为剑士最大的优点之一是拥有大量的HP，这意味着他们能更轻松地承受敌人的攻击。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
After learning some strong attack skills, the Swordman is almost unbeatable in a melee fight.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在学习了一些强力攻击技能后，剑士在近战中几乎无人能敌。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
In Ragnarok Online, Swordman generally takes the position of tanker, protecting characters of other classes from being attacked or hurt.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在《仙境传说》中，剑士通常担任坦克的角色，保护其他职业的角色免受攻击或伤害。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
A Swordman is the ideal character to take the position of party leader. When advancing to the Second Job Class, Swordmen can change their jobs to ^8E2323Knights^000000 or ^8E2323Crusaders^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
剑士是担任队伍首领的理想人选。在转职为二转职业时，剑士可以转职为^8E2323骑士^000000或^8E2323十字军^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The Mage class specializes in using the forces of Fire, Water, Earth and Lightning to attack their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
魔法师职业擅长利用火、水、土和雷的力量攻击敌人。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
However, due to their weak physical strength, they are only allowed to equip Rods and Knives as weapons, and wear light armor for defense.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
然而，由于体力较弱，他们只能装备法杖和匕首作为武器，并穿着轻型护甲进行防御。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Despite their physical weakness, they are able to do massive damage with their powerful spells. This fact alone attracts many people to join this class.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
尽管体力较弱，但他们能凭借强大的法术造成巨额伤害。仅凭这一点就吸引了许多人选择这个职业。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
In Ragnarok Online, the Mage takes a heavily offensive role in parties and is depended upon to deal great damage to enemies.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在《仙境传说》中，魔法师在队伍中担任主要的输出角色，负责对敌人造成大量伤害。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
When advancing to the Second Job Class, Mages can change their jobs to ^8E2323Wizards^000000 or ^8E2323Sages^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在转职为二转职业时，魔法师可以转职为^8E2323巫师^000000或^8E2323贤者^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The Archer class are experts in using Bow weapons, and are useful in parties for their long range attacks.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
弓箭手职业是擅长使用弓的专家，在队伍中因其远程攻击能力而非常有用。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Despite being physically weaker, Archers possess high accuracy with powerful long range bows. This allows them to attack and kill monsters from a safe distance.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
尽管体力较弱，但弓箭手拥有极高的命中率和强大的远程弓。这使他们能够在安全的距离外攻击并击杀魔物。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
In Ragnarok Online, Archers have relatively little HP, but their long range attacks allow them to easily dispatch enemies before the enemy gets close enough to hurt them.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在《仙境传说》中，弓箭手的HP相对较少，但他们的远程攻击使他们能够在敌人靠近造成伤害之前轻松解决它们。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
When advancing to the Second Job Class, every Archer may advance to the ^8E2323Hunter^000000 class. Alternatively, male Archers may advance to become ^8E2323Bards^000000, and female Archers may become ^8E2323Dancers^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在转职为二转职业时，所有弓箭手都可以转职为^8E2323猎人^000000。或者，男性弓箭手可以转职为^8E2323诗人^000000，女性弓箭手可以转职为^8E2323舞娘^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The Merchant class specializes in commerce. Due to the strong influence of the Merchant Guild, the Merchant class is attractive to those who wish to focus on earning Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
商人职业擅长商业。由于商人公会的强大影响力，商人职业对希望专注于赚取Zeny的人来说很有吸引力。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
In Ragnarok Online, the Merchant class possesses various economic abilities. Merchants can learn to sell items to NPCs for higher prices, as well as receive discounts from NPCs.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在《仙境传说》中，商人职业拥有各种经济能力。商人可以学习以更高的价格向NPC出售物品，也可以从NPC处获得折扣。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
In addition, Merchants may rent
a Cart that greatly expands their carrying capacity and allows them to open shops with their own items and prices.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
此外，商人可以租用手推车，这极大地扩展了他们的携带容量，并允许他们用自己的物品和价格开设商店。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
When advancing to the Second Job Class, Merchants can change their jobs to ^8E2323Blacksmiths^000000 or ^8E2323Alchemists^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在转职为二转职业时，商人可以转职为^8E2323铁匠^000000或^8E2323炼金术士^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Thieves are experts at using Dagger class weapons. They strike quickly and easily evade attacks from their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
盗贼是短剑类武器的专家。他们出手迅速，并能轻松躲避敌人的攻击。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Thieves can learn skills that allow them to hide from their enemies, or steal items from monsters. They are also feared for their use of poison, which slowly weakens
their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
盗贼可以学习从敌人面前躲藏，或从魔物身上偷窃物品的技能。他们使用毒药的能力也令人畏惧，毒药会慢慢削弱敌人。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
When advancing to the Second Job Class, Thieves can change their jobs to ^8E2323Assassins^000000 or ^8E2323Rogues^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在转职为二转职业时，盗贼可以转职为^8E2323刺客^000000或^8E2323流氓^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
In Ragnarok Online, Acolytes act as messengers of God in Rune-Midgarts. They possess skills that support their allies, as well as the life saving Heal ability.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在《仙境传说》中，服事是卢恩·米德加兹的神之使者。他们拥有支援队友的技能，以及能救命的治愈术。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The Acolyte's support abilities make them a welcome addition to any party. In difficult situations, the Acolyte's skills will ensure the survival of the party, allowing other members to focus on offense.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
服事的支援能力使他们成为任何队伍中受欢迎的成员。在艰难的情况下，服事的技能将确保队伍的生存，让其他成员专注于进攻。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
When advancing to the Second Job Class, Acolytes can change their jobs to ^8E2323Priests^000000 or ^8E2323Monks^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
在转职为二转职业时，服事可以转职为^8E2323牧师^000000或^8E2323武僧^000000。

[Bruce]
Hanson is waiting
for you now. Good luck
out there, young Novice.
scripts.translation:
[布鲁斯]
汉森正在等你。祝你在外面好运，年轻的初心者。
